items.title: Louis Nelson Interview, 1960-04-18
items.q: you come over this side you hear Desvien

ctx.x: All the same time. People like that, you couldn't, you couldn't hear. You on that side you just go and hear Celestan, you come over this side you hear Desvien, you're in the hall, you're going to hear René. That's all you couldn't hear. Somebody would be outdoors in that big, big old space, yeah, big old yard they had. On Daniel Street. That's right, that's right. Sure.
